faq.question: What does Moussa mean?
faq.answer: Moussa is associated with the Arabic form مُوسَى, whose core sense is moussa; moses (prophet).

faq.question: What is the origin of Moussa?
faq.answer: Moussa is associated with Arabic. Moussa is Arabic مُوسَى (Mūsā), the Quranic form of the prophet Moses.

faq.question: Is Moussa an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form مُوسَى is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Moussa an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Moussa can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Moussa a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Moussa should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Mūsā is the Quranic Arabic form of the prophet Moses and occurs in the Quran.
